title: TabsSetPanelParams
description: Params for recording which sidebar panel a tab shows, and whether it is collapsed. Two values and not one: a collapsed panel remembers the view it reopens on, which is the behaviour the activity bar's toggle has always had. The view is a string the store does not judge — the renderer owns the registry of views, exactly as it owns a tab's palette, so a value a newer renderer understands is carried rather than refused.

view.description: The view id, or "" for a tab whose panel shows nothing. Bounded because it is a name, not a document: no view id in this build is longer than a handful of characters.
